{
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "review_aspect_domain", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.95, "rationale": "Domain categorization gives a genuine axis to cross-tab facets by sentiment. All five samples correctly read (doll=physical, Lamott book=media_book, Eamon=music, skin cream=physical, Bicycle Thieves=film)."},
    {"name": "product_quality_signal", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.92, "rationale": "Praised/criticized/mixed is a useful facet distinct from the raw label and correlates well with sentiment analysis. Sample readings are sound (Lamott 'mixed', cream 'praised')."},
    {"name": "emotional_intensity", "analytical_usefulness": 0.6, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "rationale": "An ordinal intensity scale gives modeling leverage, but the scale is subjective and hard to fully ground; e.g. the calm cream review rated same '3' as harsh critiques is defensible but not clearly warranted. Reasonable but somewhat interpretive."},
    {"name": "negative_emotion_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Fine-grained negative emotion is a strong facet for sentiment comparison. Samples grounded (disappointment for doll, disgust for Eamon rant, not_present for positive reviews)."},
    {"name": "positive_emotion_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.88, "rationale": "Complements negative emotion; useful facet. Readings mostly sound, though 'love_affection' vs 'calm_satisfaction' for the enthusiastic cream review is a mild judgment call, still defensible."},
    {"name": "expectation_outcome", "analytical_usefulness": 0.82, "source_groundedness": 0.82, "rationale": "Expectation framing is a genuine analytical axis. Some inference: 'exceeded_expectations' for the cream and 'met_expectations' for the film are plausible but not explicitly stated, minor over-confidence where text is silent on prior expectations."},
    {"name": "defect_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Structured defect taxonomy is useful for negative-review analysis. Sample values well grounded (content_quality_flaw for book/music, not_present elsewhere)."},
    {"name": "recommendation_stance", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Recommendation stance is a strong, distinct facet. Readings sound (explicit recommend/discourage extracted from 'recommend'/'skip it' cues), with implicit/explicit distinction reasonable."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.82,
  "source_groundedness": 0.88,
  "rationale": "The added columns supply multiple genuinely distinct facets (domain, quality valence, emotion types, expectation framing, defect taxonomy, recommendation stance) that give real leverage for comparing facets across sentiment labels; none are near-constant or trivially redundant with the original label. Values are largely sound readings of the source text; the main minor weakness is interpretive/over-confident inference in emotional_intensity and expectation_outcome where the text is partly silent, but these remain defensible and no clear hallucinations were observed in the samples."
}
